 Hon'Ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State.
2. The instant application u/s 528 Bnss has been filed by the applicant with prayer to quash the
entire proceedings of Case No. 15 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 19 of 2023 (State vs.
Akhilesh Patel and others) under Sections 354(B), 376 Ipc, Police Station Santnagar, District
Mirzapur as well as impugned summoning order dated 31.5.2023 passed by Additional Civil Judge
(Jd)/ Judicial Magistrate, court no. 6, Mirzapur.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has already been enlarged on bail by order of this Court dated 24.1.2024 in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 52340 of 2023 wherein detailed reasoning has been given.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No. 52340 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He next submitted that the victim has an estranged relationship with her husband being a married lady; the applicant was a source of strength and comfort to the victim; the applicant accompanied the victim to the trial court on various dates; over the period of time, the victim and the applicant developed a fondness for each other and engaged in a consensual physical relationship, which cannot be terms as rape; the victim was never confined by the applicant in any manner; she was present at various public place but she did not raise any alarm nor did she resist the applicant; her conduct shows that she was a consenting party.

The victim became pregnant over the period of time, however, the applicant disputed her claim that he is father of the child;
medical evidence does not corroborates the allegation of rape made by the victim against the applicant; prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence; he is no prior criminal history; he has been falsely implicated in the case.
4. Per contra, learned AGA submitted that from very perusal of FIR, a clear case of rape and outraging modesty of woman is made out, therefore, no case for interference is made out.

5. In view of the above facts and submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, cognizable offence is made out on the basis of FIR version and other material on record, therefore, no good case has been made out for interference by this Court.

However, the applicant is at liberty to file discharge application before the court below wherein all grounds made in present application, may be taken and if such application is filed, the same shall be heard and decided by the court below after giving opportunity of hearing to both side, strictly in accordance with law.
6.
The application stands disposed of with above observations.

(Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.) September 3, 2025 Dhirendra/
